name: local-ai-gateway
title: Local AI Gateway
description: Ask Claude Code, Codex CLI, or the Anthropic/OpenAI APIs from Raycast using your existing CLI logins. Streaming, sessions, projects, agents, AI commands, memory and automations.
author: iamrivershenshuhe

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Chat with Claude Code, Codex or an API provider. Streaming, multi-turn, resumable.

commands.name: quick-ai
commands.title: Quick AI
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: One-shot question, answer shown immediately.

commands.name: ask-selected-text
commands.title: Ask Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Ask about the text currently selected in the frontmost app.

commands.name: ask-clipboard
commands.title: Ask Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Ask about the current clipboard contents.

commands.name: quick-fix
commands.title: Quick Fix
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Fix grammar, spelling or code in the selected text and paste the result back.

commands.name: chat-history
commands.title: Chat History
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Browse, continue, pin, archive or delete past conversations.

commands.name: manage-models
commands.title: Manage Models & Providers
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Detect Claude Code / Codex installs and login state, test providers, see default models.

commands.name: search-agents
commands.title: Search Agents
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Browse and chat with your custom agents (persona + provider + permissions + project).

commands.name: create-agent
commands.title: Create Agent
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Create a reusable agent with its own instructions, provider, model and permission mode.

commands.name: import-agents
commands.title: Import Agents
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Import agents from a JSON file.

commands.name: manage-projects
commands.title: Projects
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Working directories the CLI agents can read (and, with permission, edit).

commands.name: search-ai-commands
commands.title: Search AI Commands
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Run prompt templates on selected text or clipboard: explain, fix, summarize, translate.

commands.name: create-ai-command
commands.title: Create AI Command
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Create a prompt template with {selection}, {clipboard} and {input} placeholders.

commands.name: import-ai-commands
commands.title: Import AI Commands
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Import AI commands from a JSON file.

commands.name: profile
commands.title: Profile
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Context you want available in every conversation (except AI Commands).

commands.name: show-memory
commands.title: Show Memory
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: View and edit what the assistant remembers about you.

commands.name: import-memory
commands.title: Import Memory
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Import a memory summary from a text or JSON file.

commands.name: manage-automations
commands.title: Manage Automations
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Prompts that run on a schedule in the background and keep their latest result.

commands.name: create-automation
commands.title: Create Automation
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Schedule a prompt to run every 15 minutes, hourly, daily or weekly.

commands.name: run-automations
commands.title: Run Due Automations
commands.subtitle: Local AI Gateway
commands.description: Background runner for automations (also runnable manually).

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Provider used for new chats.

preferences.name: cliAuthMode
preferences.title: CLI Authentication
preferences.description: Use the CLI's existing login (subscription quota) or inject your API key into the CLI.

preferences.name: permissionMode
preferences.title: Default Permission Mode
preferences.description: Ask: answer only. Read: may read the project. Agent: may edit files. Full: may run commands.

preferences.name: claudeModel
preferences.title: Claude Code Model
preferences.description: Model alias or id passed to claude --model (leave empty for CLI default).

preferences.name: codexModel
preferences.title: Codex Model
preferences.description: Model passed to codex -m (leave empty for CLI default).

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude Executable
preferences.description: Leave empty to auto-detect.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Executable
preferences.description: Leave empty to auto-detect.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Stored encrypted by Raycast. Used by the Anthropic API provider and by Claude Code when CLI Authentication is set to API Key.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Stored encrypted by Raycast. Used by the OpenAI API provider and by Codex when CLI Authentication is set to API Key.

preferences.name: anthropicModel
preferences.title: Anthropic API Model
preferences.description: Model id for the Anthropic API provider.

preferences.name: openaiModel
preferences.title: OpenAI API Model
preferences.description: Model id for the OpenAI API provider.

preferences.name: saveHistory
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Save chat history
preferences.description: Keep conversations in Raycast local storage so they can be resumed.

preferences.name: historyScope
preferences.title: Conversation History
preferences.description: Show Quick AI and Ask AI conversations combined or keep them separate.

preferences.name: startNewChatAfter
preferences.title: Start New Chat
preferences.description: Start a new chat after this much inactivity when opening Ask AI.

preferences.name: followUpBehavior
preferences.title: Follow-up Behavior
preferences.description: Queue follow-ups while the agent runs, or steer (cancel and redirect) the current run.

preferences.name: autoArchiveDays
preferences.title: Auto-Archive Chats
preferences.description: Archive chats after this period of inactivity. Pinned chats never get auto-archived.

preferences.name: showProviderBadge
preferences.title: Privacy
preferences.label: Show which provider receives each request
preferences.description: Display the provider and model on every answer so you always know where data is sent.

preferences.name: finishToast
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Show a toast when a chat finishes
preferences.description: Useful when a long agent run finishes while you look elsewhere.

preferences.name: warnDeleteChats
preferences.title: Warnings
preferences.label: Show warning before deleting chats
preferences.description: Ask for confirmation before deleting a chat.

preferences.name: warnDeleteAgents
preferences.label: Show warning before deleting agents
preferences.description: Ask for confirmation before deleting an agent.

preferences.name: warnDeleteCommands
preferences.label: Show warning before deleting AI commands
preferences.description: Ask for confirmation before deleting or hiding an AI command.

preferences.name: warnDeleteAutomations
preferences.label: Show warning before deleting automations
preferences.description: Ask for confirmation before deleting an automation.

preferences.name: maxContextChars
preferences.title: Max Context Characters
preferences.description: Selected text, clipboard or file content longer than this is truncated before sending.
